message: docs(runtime): measured call sites, measured size, and an issue for the deferred state machine

edits.find: Thirty-one call sites move, all in tests.
edits.replace: Thirty-three call sites move, all in tests, and that count is measured on the final head rather than estimated before it: twenty `vi.spyOn(..., "invalidate")` retargets across five files, and thirteen direct `GraphRuntime` calls across three. `membership-gating`'s seed-contract case is rewritten wholesale rather than moved, so it is counted apart from those thirty-three rather than folded into them. The thirty-one this record first carried undercounted the spies by three, because a bounded text search returns a limited number of matches per file and both `motion-consistency` and `demo-runtime-authoring` hold more than it returned. `tsc` named all three exactly, which is the useful half of that mistake: after decision one a spy on a member `GraphRuntime` no longer declares is a compile error rather than a silent runtime throw, so the type system is the exhaustive oracle for an inventory of this shape and a search is not.
